crossRefs.note: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t…
Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they…
and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you…
You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you…
Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified…
You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.
You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.
You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and…
For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the…
The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
